note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved: wrapper is the Cantor-unpairing prefix followed by the unchanged precision machine; pairing_system_iff proves the pairing equations have the unique Cantor solution, and precisionCircuit_poly gives the new polynomial as the specialized halting polynomial squared plus the four squared differences. Proved, no assumed hypothesis.

theorem pairing_system_iff (c : Fin 5 → ℕ) (t : Fin 4 → ℕ) :
    (∀ i : Fin 4, 2 * (t i : ℤ) - ((c i.castSucc : ℤ) + tNext t c i) *
        ((c i.castSucc : ℤ) + tNext t c i + 1) - 2 * (tNext t c i : ℤ) = 0) ↔
      t 3 = pair (c 3) (c 4) ∧ t 2 = pair (c 2) (t 3) ∧ t 1 = pair (c 1) (t 2) ∧
        t 0 = pair (c 0) (t 1) := by
